summary: ```markdown # CLO Technique Mini Classroom - Adding Seam Allowance ## Introduction Hello everyone! Today, we are going to talk about the little techniques to add fonts in CLO. ## Importing a .dxf File First, import a .dxf file. In the pop-up window, select the option to convert to font. This can help you convert the font information in the .dxf file to the font in CLO. After opening, you can see the font information displayed in the window. ### Display Font Settings If there is no normal display font in your window, you can find the display font in the 2D window display menu. Open the display settings, and you can see the normal display font. ## Checking Font Information Then, let's check the font information of the sleeve version on the right. For the fonts that are not correctly identified, we can add and correct them in CLO. ### Adding Saved Font First, let's add the saved font of the sleeve. You can find the font tool in the 2D toolbar. Then, click once to add the font. You can add the font on the two outside pages. ## Modifying Font Properties In the property editor, you can modify the font type, width, and seam type. ### Working on the Sleeve Page Next, let's first deal with the sleeve page, focusing on the cross point connection method at the top. Select this section of the font; we can find it in the property editor. In the property editor, set the cross point as the second type. ### Connection Effects of Fonts Let's see the connection effect of the six types of fonts. You can adjust it according to the actual craftsmanship. ## Creating Uneven Seam Widths Next, let's create an uneven width of the seam. First, select this page line. In the property editor, change the seam type to point. Then we can set the two ends of a line for different seam widths. ### Default Seam Width The default is the line type. The whole seam is the effect of uniform width. The translation in the software will be updated later. We can follow the arrow direction in the 2D window. ### Adjusting Seam Width Change the width of the end to 10 mm. On the other side, we can change the width of the seam to the correct 10 mm. Similarly, we can edit the opening width of the seam. ## Conclusion So, we can modify the seam as needed. ```
